cases.scenario: itemCount on a brand equals only its approved/active, non-deleted, non-mid-deletion-seller listings (LIVE_LISTING_WHERE)
cases.preconditions: Needs a brand fixture whose listings span draft/sold/soft-deleted/active states (and ideally one from a seller mid-account-deletion) - none exists in fixtures.json today
cases.test_data: No brand fixture currently defined in fixtures.json (no brand ids/states recorded at all)
cases.steps: GET /brands; compare returned itemCount for the mixed-state brand against the count of only its approved/active listings
cases.response_assertions: itemCount for the mixed-state brand == count(listings where status in (approved,active) AND not soft-deleted AND seller.deletionScheduledFor is null)
cases.business_outcome: itemCount must exclude draft/pending_approval/rejected/inactive/soft-deleted/mid-deletion-seller listings, per LIVE_LISTING_WHERE
cases.expected: itemCount reflects only live listings, per brands.repository.ts:12-23 + listing.constants.ts:68-92
cases.blocked_reason: No brand fixture exists with listings in mixed states (draft/sold/soft-deleted/active) to verify itemCount exclusion; fixtures.json has no brand entries at all
cases.source: audit EP-032 suggested scenario #3; brands.repository.ts:12-23; listing.constants.ts:68-92 (LIVE_LISTING_WHERE)

cases.scenario: A brand with zero live listings still appears in the list with itemCount: 0 (not filtered out)
cases.preconditions: Needs a brand fixture whose only listings are draft/sold (i.e. zero live listings) - none exists in fixtures.json today
cases.test_data: No zero-live-listing brand fixture currently recorded in fixtures.json
cases.steps: GET /brands; locate the zero-live-listing brand in the returned array
cases.response_assertions: the brand is present in the array; its itemCount == 0
cases.business_outcome: Brands are never filtered out for having no live listings - the repository query has no `where` excluding zero-count brands
cases.expected: Brand present with itemCount: 0, consistent with mobile test fixture brandsApi.test.ts:15
cases.blocked_reason: No brand fixture with itemCount=0 (zero live listings) is recorded in fixtures.json to locate/verify on QA

cases.scenario: Response ordering: does GET /brands return the admin-curated/insertion order the app/doc assume, or the alphabetical order the code produces?
cases.preconditions: CF-032-01 open: app code comments (Explore.tsx:52-55, BrandListing.tsx:26-29) and docs/features/brand-drill-down.md:16 assume an admin-curated/insertion order; code sorts alphabetically (brands.repository.ts:14, orderBy:{name:'asc'}); Brand model has no sortOrder/order column at all (schema.prisma:514-524, CF-032-02) to back the doc's premise
cases.test_data: Needs >=7 brand fixtures with a deliberate insertion order different from alphabetical to distinguish the two hypotheses - none recorded in fixtures.json
cases.steps: GET /brands; record the actual order of returned brand names/ids
cases.expected: Unclear/Conflict - do not assert a specific order as pass/fail until product/dev clarify which order is actually required
cases.blocked_reason: CF-032-01/CF-032-02: requirement (doc/app assumption of admin-curated order) conflicts with code (alphabetical, no order column exists at all) - needs product/dev clarification before an expected order can be asserted
cases.source: audit EP-032 suggested scenario #5; Source agreement matrix row 'Response ordering'

cases.scenario: Guest Explore 'Shop by brand' taster rail (first 6 brands, TAXONOMY_RAIL_LIMIT) is meant per doc to show admin-curated brands, but will always show the first 6 alphabetically in practice
cases.preconditions: CF-032-01 open (same root cause as BR:ordering-conflict)
cases.test_data: Needs >6 brand fixtures seeded to exercise the TAXONOMY_RAIL_LIMIT=6 slice - none recorded in fixtures.json
cases.steps: Open guest Explore screen with >6 brands seeded; observe which 6 brands the taster rail shows
cases.expected: Unclear/Conflict - document actual (first 6 alphabetically) vs intended (admin-curated) behaviour; do not assert a specific set as pass without product clarification
cases.blocked_reason: CF-032-01: same ordering conflict as BR:ordering-conflict, surfaced in the guest Explore UI; also needs >6 brands seeded (screens/guest/Explore.tsx:101,52-55)

cases.scenario: Raw HTTP response includes all 7 Brand fields (id, name, slug, logo, navigationTab, createdAt, itemCount), including the 4 the mobile app never reads

cases.source: audit EP-032 suggested scenario #7; brands.repository.ts:22 (...brand spread); brandsApi.ts:4-15 (slug/logo dropped); types/domain.ts:26-30 (navigationTab/createdAt never typed)

cases.response_assertions: array unchanged (same content as a plain GET /brands call); no 5xx; no error body
cases.expected: 200, unaffected; confirms no data leak or crash from injection-shaped junk query strings

cases.scenario: Malformed/garbage Authorization header does not cause a 401/500 - no guard parses it on this route

cases.expected: 200 unaffected - a garbage Authorization header is simply never read on this unguarded route
cases.source: audit EP-032 Test design inputs (a); brands.controller.ts:6-14 (no @UseGuards, no role decorator)
